scope: On the Becoming core's laws of copying, closure, cuts and judging through a reduction: MaterialMaturation's route is copying a recipe from a pool with one unit of support drawn per attachment (route_some_iff), so by Copying.empties_iff preparation completes with an empty residual pool exactly when the pool is a permutation of the recipe and the recipe is no longer than the support (preparation_empties_iff, preparation_leaves). In GrownFragmentation, being connected by the bonds is lying within the closure under them (connected_iff_within); a component holding its root and closed on every remaining bond is that closure by closure_iff_certified (component_is_closure, certificate_exact_split_by_core), and a certified cut leaves its two ends apart by not_within_of_closed (cut_separates). The bonds read both ways are Cuts.Links (adjacent_iff_links); division keeps them grown by attachment whatever the word (develop_attached), so by Cuts.attached_link_separates every bond of every body grown by division separates its ends when cut (bond_cut_separates, every_grown_bond_separates), and after one aggregation, by Cuts.joined_cut_unchanged_iff, cutting a grown bond changes no connection exactly where the aggregated bond crosses it (aggregate_cut_unchanged_iff), the reinforced chain's bypass being a case (reinforced_cut_unchanged). The two grown graphs share a parent summary and differ in mean cut return, so by Readout.no_judge_of_merged no function of the summary gives both (no_parent_summary_predictor_by_core). The production law, sampling, recipe, stocks and growth histories keep the earlier modules' scope; correspondence to actual material or tissue is not checked.
